summary: Owned read-only selftest verification completed to a decisive network boundary. GET to study-transcribe-v1?selftest=1 produced no HTTP response: the web retrieval runtime rejected the target as inaccessible, and an independent direct urllib GET failed during DNS resolution with Temporary failure in name resolution. No speech, transcript payload, session identifier, room token, credential, function state, or production authority was sent or changed.

evidence.observed: Target reported inaccessible by retrieval tool before an HTTP status was exposed.
URLError: Temporary failure in name resolution; no HTTP status observed.

tests: Invoked only the existing GET selftest route; no POST request was made.
Recorded only transport/status-class metadata; no response body with sensitive content was obtained.
Sent no microphone audio, transcript payload, session identifier or room token.
Did not mutate Supabase function state or production authority.
Kept the separate browser/microphone cold-start acceptance route unchanged.
unresolved: Repeat the public GET selftest only in a runtime that demonstrably has DNS resolution and unrestricted public HTTP reachability to the Supabase function origin, then record the HTTP status and non-sensitive response metadata.
